PACRITINIB_MF_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html.name: PERSIST-1
PACRITINIB_MF_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html.group: Pacritinib vs best available therapy in myelofibrosis; primary >=35% spleen volume reduction at week 24 (Mesa Lancet Haematol 2017, PERSIST-1)

allOutcomes.title: Spleen volume reduction >=35% at week 24 (primary endpoint)

PACRITINIB_MF_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html.robSource: Mesa 2017 Lancet Haematol: randomised, open-label phase 3 (PERSIST-1); blinded central spleen imaging
PACRITINIB_MF_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html.snippet: PERSIST-1 NCT01773187: Mesa RA et al. Lancet Haematol 2017;4:e225-236. Myelofibrosis, pacritinib (n=220) vs best available therapy (n=107). Primary >=35% spleen volume reduction at wk24: 42/220 (19.1%) vs 5/107 (4.7%). Per-arm counts + denominators AACT-verified.

evidence.label: Primary endpoint
evidence.text: Spleen response: Pacritinib 42/220 vs Best Available Therapy 5/107.

ANIFROLUMAB_LUPUS_2_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.htm.group: Anifrolumab 300 mg vs placebo in active SLE on standard therapy; primary BICLA response at week 52 (Morand NEJM 2020, TULIP-2)

evidence.label: Primary endpoint
evidence.text: BICLA response: Anifrolumab 300 mg 86/180 vs Placebo 57/182.
